changes: MCTS DecisionNode selection now maximizes root-player value only on root-player turns and minimizes it on opponent turns.
scripts/bench_ai.py loads release/v1.0/default_params.json and injects those kwargs for mcts_eval_v1 candidate/promotion rollout opponents.
mcts_eval_v1 candidate/promotion profile no longer uses old flat rollout or greedy_risk as the promotion path baseline.
quick_bench already supports explicit --red-kwargs / --blue-kwargs and was smoke-verified with the release default rollout kwargs.

promotion_discussion_requires: candidate benchmarks directly against current release default rollout kwargs

entry_checks.result: CLI ran with release default rollout opponent kwargs; gate failed only because 2-game entry smoke was not a strength benchmark.

entry_checks.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/quick_bench.py --red mcts_eval_v1 --blue rollout --red-kwargs <small mcts kwargs> --blue-kwargs <release default rollout kwargs> --games 1 --max-turns 8 --no-save-report
entry_checks.result: quick_bench accepted explicit release default rollout kwargs and produced ai_versions.blue with cutoff_eval=zweistein and deadline_safety_ms=30.0.
